elements.name: Create from a selected template in a collapsed group

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active with `Sketch1` visible in the MCAD Software
the template chooser shows the metric folder grouped by type
Standard (mm) is selected in the expanded Part group
the user collapses the Part group
its template tiles are hidden
the details pane still identifies Standard (mm) as a millimeter part template
Create remains enabled
the user chooses Create
the chooser closes and a new empty part becomes active
a new document tab is visible alongside the original part
the user closes the new unedited part
the original part becomes active
the user reopens the template chooser in the same session
the Part group remains collapsed
the details pane identifies Standard (mm) and Create is enabled
the user expands the Part group
Standard (mm) is shown as the selected template
the user cancels the chooser
the original part remains active
